messages:
sam: Quick heads-up — FinTechEU wants a 2-week POC with EU-only processing + canary failover. They asked for: list of sub-processors by EU region, explicit routing/failover policy (deny vs fallback), and a pricing delta for Dedicated reserved pool vs hosted with geo-fallback. Also: security questionnaire Q10 about logs/traces leaving the EU. cc @ida @maria

ida: Got it. I'll coordinate ops and legal. Can you paste the SAML org id and the expected qps/seq length so we can size the Dedicated pool?

sam: SAML org id: FIN-EU-003. Traffic for POC: ~25 rps steady, spike 120 rps burst. Typical seq len ~512 tokens.

maria: Legal: we can provide sub-processor list and SCCs. Important: hosted telemetry/usage metrics sometimes flow to analytics endpoints outside EU unless we enable EU-only telemetry. For Dedicated/Private we can opt to keep logs in-region — I need ops to confirm retention buckets.

jonah: Infra note: defaults are different across deployment modes. TL;DR:
- Dedicated/Private: logs/ingestion can be pinned to eu-west-1 or eu-central-1 (no cross-region replication by default)
- Hosted: control plane metadata and anonymized telemetry may cross to control plane region; we offer a "restrict-region: EU" routing flag to minimize that but it disables cross-region fallback.

jonah: Example routing config we can apply for the POC (we'll template this into the POC runbook):
```yaml
routing:
  primary_region: eu-west-1
  failover_region: eu-central-1
  failover_behavior: fallback_with_warning # options: deny, fallback_with_warning, silent_fallback
  telemetry_retention_region: eu-west-1
  subprocessor_visibility: true
```

ida: Ops can spin up a 4-GPU dedicated pool for the 2-week POC. Pricing delta (rough, pre-approval): Dedicated reserved short-term commit ~ "$7.5k/week" for that size; hosted with geo-fallback estimated token+throughput cost ~ "$3k/week" but with risk of cross-region egress and potential rate-limits. I'll formalize these in a quote.

kelly: I can provision the Dedicated pool once we have PO + network allowlist. Also will fill the sub-processor spreadsheet (link below) with region-specific partners (AWS, GCP, Azure, Datadog for logs). Please add any additional third parties the customer requires us to disclose: https://redwood-internal/ops/subproc-eu-poc

sec-review-bot: Security Q10 response (draft): "For Dedicated/Private deployments, application logs and request traces are stored in the chosen EU region and not replicated outside EU unless explicit opt-in. For Hosted deployments, control-plane telemetry is routed to our centralized analytics service; we offer an EU-only telemetry option that disables cross-region aggregation but may disable cross-region failover." See policy: https://redwood-internal/security/telemetry-routing

maria: I'll include SCCs and note the EU-only telemetry option as a contractual addendum. Two asks for legal ops: confirm if Datadog is acceptable for customer (they have strict vendor list) and whether the customer requires HSM-backed KMS — that affects timeline.

sam: Thanks — next steps: 1) Ida: draft quote with both options and include the routing config snippet; 2) Kelly: provision dedicated pool after PO; 3) Maria: finalize subproc list + SCC note; 4) Jonah: produce a short runbook for enabling EU-only telemetry. I'll consolidate and send to prospect today. :thumbsup:
